testimonial: {"root":{"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I played Bingo Bard at the Serious Play conference on the Duke University campus. Far from a trite bingo game that asks you to find someone who likes the same flavor of ice cream as you, Bingo Bard got me out and about on campus to places I would have never have explored otherwise. Trudging through the heat to see the interior of the amazing chapel or wandering through the library to find medieval manuscripts, a case of glass eyes, and a special exhibit of game miniatures gave me a fun break from the conference and some much-needed air-conditioning.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}}

testimonial: {"root":{"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Bingo Bard was a welcome addition to Serious Play. It was a fun, low-pressure way for attendees to explore the conference, engage with exhibitors and activities, and connect with one another throughout the event. We especially loved how the challenges encouraged people to notice and participate in parts of the conference they might otherwise have missed. It added an extra layer of playfulness and discovery that fit perfectly with the spirit of Serious Play, and the response from our community was overwhelmingly positive.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}}

testimonial: {"root":{"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I've experienced Bingo Bard as a participant with my 11-year-old, as well as a conference organizer. In both cases, it proved to be a powerful tool for structured exploration, leading to more connections and more fun.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}}

{"root":{"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I love how versatile the concept of Bingo Bard is and how it helps remind me to engage with parts of a conference I might have otherwise missed. Seeing it at local events, it’s become something I look forward to each time. It’s like a little scavenger hunt, combined with a to-do list that gives me little bursts of dopamine, and it was a fun surprise seeing the rewards people won at the end of the event! If I were an event organizer, I think I would really appreciate being able to use BB to direct the attendees toward lesser known booths or talks, and to be able to see metrics on the most popular areas.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}}

{"root":{"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"RIoT has been an event organizer for more than a decade and we're always aiming to push the envelope when it comes to wow-factors and audience engagement. Bingo Bard was a simple and effective way to inject more fun and whimsy into our tech exhibiting event at the Raleigh Convention Center. The bingo game was custom designed to drive event participants to our exhibitors. Bingo is universal, and as I expected, it activated a part of our audience that would typically be more passive in approaching the startups and sponsors that we were showcasing at RIoT Demo Night.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}}
